cases.label: Multi-Beat Anime/AAA Ability from Source Footage
required_tools_ordered: parallax vfx chart <set> + 1 test frame (Owner Stop 1)
parallax vfx comp/ink + Blender fx textures

forbidden_tools.why: Building from lore text + memory without real source frames produces generic effects that miss the scene's timing and visual language.
All-additive long-lived layers blow out bloom and produce uniform glow without depth.
Ignoring a moving camera misaligns effects with the shot's perspective.
Skipping the VFX method plan means the effect has no structural rationale and misses techniques.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: build a full multi-beat anime ultimate from source footage with breakdown and animatic
recreate a scene's ability sequence with beat chart, animatic and stylesheet
produce an AAA anime multi-beat vfx set with timing breakdown and vault check

cases.label: Melee Sword Slash, Punch, Kick, Weapon Impact
required_tools_ordered: swing-plane arc v2 (jag, ridge, twist, strands) + sweep {head, tail} + blade_glint

forbidden_tools.why: Untextured Neon ribbons read as a 'white barcode' — no depth, no texture, no Blender fx pass.
Impact frames on tiny on-screen elements waste budget; only use when frames_on_screen >= 3%.
Impact frames without hit-stop float in time and lose their physical readability.

cases.label: Character Aura, Power-Up, Sustained Energy Field
required_tools_ordered: Hybrid base (saiyan_ssj_3d rule): VfxMesh flame/spiral shells
flipbook cards (~44% non-additive, dark twin behind bright core, <=4 hues)

forbidden_tools.why: All-mesh aura rebuilds collapse to 'so bad' — no non-additive cards means blown-out bloom with no depth.
Edge-on sprite rings are invisible at most camera angles and produce a flicker band.
Blown-out bloom from over-additive layering loses the aura's form and reads as a white smear.

cases.label: Ground Shatter, Cloth Banner, Soft Body, Sand/Ash, Hair, Water/Liquid, Shockwave
required_tools_ordered: parallax vfx fracture (+ rest:true + settle + VfxDebris collision group) for shattering
parallax vfx cloth (shape: seq) for cloth/banner

parallax vfx soft / parallax vfx sand / parallax vfx hair / parallax vfx geonodes / parallax vfx water / parallax vfx liquid / parallax vfx field / parallax vfx points / parallax vfx comp --new shock for respective sim type

forbidden_tools.why: Thrown random rocks for shattering produce uniform debris with no surface-read of the broken material.
A wobbling plane for cloth/hair has no structural silhouette and no secondary motion folds.
A scaled cone for sand has no particle flow and reads as a solid object.
Lit puff card swarms for smoke (quenchstrike graveyard) produce a uniform blob with no volumetric read.

mandatory_gates: methods_gate (shatter/cloth/smoke beats MUST use sim tool or explicit --not owner reason)
cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.

anti_patterns_regex.message: Graveyard: `erode` on MeshPart/EditableMesh is blocked — Roblox runtime ignores vertex alpha and TextureID alpha on MeshPart/EditableMesh; use `vfx dissolve` with `surface: 1` and a flipbook instead.

examples: create a ground shatter effect using fracture sim with VfxDebris collision
build a cloth banner destruction effect with cloth sim and secondary folds
make a sand-storm particle destruction using the vfx sand simulator

cases.label: Original Effect with No Anime Source Scene
required_tools_ordered: parallax vfx director new <name> --idea "..." (>=3 beats, own palette, >=1 unused technique, what it is NOT)

forbidden_tools.why: Brief-only originals with zero real frames scored 4-6 vs 8+ with real frames (R-vfx-5 finding).
Swapping the genre to be 'different' (e.g., comic-book filter on anime scene) is not originality.
Re-skinning the last golden effect is a graveyard route — the library is for mechanics, not look.

cases.label: Breaking/Dissolving Runtime EditableMesh Shell
required_tools_ordered: set texture + surface:1 + flipbook layout:4x4 + mode:OneShot + over:[start, end]

forbidden_tools.why: The `erode` key on MeshPart/EditableMesh is a graveyard route: Roblox runtime ignores vertex alpha and TextureID alpha at runtime — the mesh never visually erodes.
